title: Connect to Supported Web3 Wallets Successfully
description: Verify that the user can connect to supported Web3 wallets like MetaMask and Coinbase Wallet, with appropriate loading indicators and error handling.

steps.description: Navigate to the main faucet page.
Click on the wallet connect button.
Select MetaMask wallet and approve connection.
Check that the wallet connection is established and UI reflects the connected status.
Disconnect and reconnect using Coinbase Wallet.
Verify successful MetaMask and Coinbase wallet connections with loading states shown during connection attempts.

title: Wallet Connection Error Handling
description: Ensure that errors during wallet connection are gracefully handled and error messages are displayed to the user.

steps.description: Simulate wallet connection rejection by user in MetaMask.
Confirm that the error boundary captures the error and displays an informative message.
Simulate a wallet connection failure due to unsupported browser.
Verify that the UI shows an appropriate error message and does not crash.

title: Ad Verification 10-Second Timer Enforcement
description: Validate that the interactive advertisement enforces a full 10-second view timer before allowing claim eligibility.

steps.description: Initiate ad viewing on the faucet page.
Attempt to skip the ad before the 10-second timer completes.
Confirm that skipping is not allowed and user must complete the full 10 seconds.
Complete the 10-second timer fully.
Verify server-side session verification confirms eligibility.

title: Ad Verification Server-Side Session Validation
description: Test backend verification of ad sessions to ensure only valid ad views allow token claims.

steps.description: Trigger ad viewing and retrieve session token.
Call backend verify-ad API with valid session.
Confirm backend validates session as successful.
Call verify-ad API with an expired or tampered session.
Ensure backend rejects session and returns appropriate error.

title: Rate Limiting Enforces IP and Wallet Restrictions
description: Verify multi-layer rate limiting prevents multiple claims from the same IP or wallet address within the cooldown period.

steps.description: Submit a valid ETH claim from a wallet and IP.
Check that ETH transfer is successful and user receives transaction status.
Immediately submit a subsequent claim from the same wallet.
Confirm claim is blocked with rate limit error and user receives cooldown feedback.
Submit claim from a different wallet but same IP repeatedly.
Ensure rate limiting blocks claims exceeding the permitted IP frequency.

title: ETH Transfer Backend Security and Limits
description: Check backend adheres to environment-secured private keys and transfer limits during ETH drip transactions.

steps.description: Trigger ETH transfer via backend API with valid claim request.
Verify private keys are not exposed and transfer respects environment-defined limits.
Send multiple rapid requests to backend drip API exceeding allowed limits.
Confirm backend denies excessive requests and returns informative error.

title: Token Claim Interface Displays Real-Time Status
description: Validate the frontend token claim interface shows user balance, ongoing transaction status, and error states accurately.

steps.description: Connect wallet and view faucet token claim interface.
Confirm user ETH balance is displayed correctly.
Submit claim and observe transaction progress UI.
Verify progress is shown including links to Etherscan.
Simulate an error during claim.
Check that meaningful error messages are displayed in UI.

title: Faucet Statistics API Provides Live Wallet Data
description: Ensure the faucet statistics API endpoint returns real-time wallet balance and operational health status correctly.

steps.description: Call the faucet-stats API endpoint.
Validate the response contains current wallet balance, transaction statuses, and health indicators.
Simulate backend error during stats retrieval.
Confirm API returns consistent and informative error responses.

title: Error Boundaries and Loading Spinners Function Correctly
description: Verify that runtime UI errors are caught by error boundaries and loading states display spinners gracefully without UI crashes.

steps.description: Induce a runtime error in a React component.
Check error boundary captures error and displays fallback UI.
Trigger data loading for wallet connection or claim status.
Ensure loading spinner is visible until data is ready.

title: Context-Based State Management Accuracy
description: Test React Context faucet state management updates and API interaction responses correctly propagate UI changes.

steps.description: Connect wallet and trigger state updates for balance and claim status.
Verify context state changes are correctly reflected in all dependent UI components.
Simulate API failures and observe context state error updates.
Confirm UI shows appropriate error states propagated by context.

title: Responsive UI and Tailwind CSS Styling Verification
description: Check faucet UI layout and styles respond correctly on various screen sizes and accessibility patterns are followed.

steps.description: Load the faucet page on desktop viewport.
Confirm that layout, colors, gradients, and components render aesthetically and functionally.
Resize viewport to tablet and mobile screen sizes.
Verify UI adjusts responsively without overlaps or hidden content.
Test keyboard navigation and screen reader accessibility.
Confirm interactive elements are accessible and follow accessible patterns.

title: Debug Tool Functionalities for Wallet and Ad Session
description: Verify debug tools display accurate wallet connection states and ad verification sessions for developer monitoring.

steps.description: Navigate to the debug tools page.
Check that connected wallet info and current session states are visible.
Trigger new ad session and observe debug API outputs.
Verify debug endpoints show accurate verification and session data.

title: API Input Validation and Consistent Error Responses
description: Ensure all API endpoints strictly validate inputs and return consistent, structured error responses upon invalid input or failure.

steps.description: Call rate-limit and drip API endpoints with malformed or missing parameters.
Confirm error responses contain clear error messages and HTTP status codes.
Call verify-ad API with invalid session tokens.
Check that error payloads are consistent with other API error formats.

title: Performance and Responsiveness Across Devices
description: Test faucet page loading times, interactions, and responsiveness on desktop and mobile devices meet performance standards.

steps.description: Measure page load times and interaction latencies on desktop with simulated network throttling.
Verify all elements load quickly and interactions are smooth.
Repeat performance measurements on various mobile devices or emulators.
Check that UI remains responsive and usable without delays.

title: Environment Secrets Are Secure and Not Exposed
description: Validate that all environment variables and private keys are securely managed in backend environment and not exposed or leaked through frontend or public sources.

steps.description: Review network traffic and frontend bundles for presence of private keys or environment secrets.
Ensure no environment variables or private keys appear in frontend code or network traffic.
Check backend code handling environment variables for secure access only.
Confirm environment variables are referenced securely and never logged or exposed.
